title: Which temple architecture style is primarily associated with northern India?
description: Identify the major temple architecture tradition of northern India.
hint: It is characterized by a curvilinear tower.
summary: Nagara architecture is the major temple architecture style of northern India.

title: Which temple architecture style is mainly associated with southern India?
description: Identify the dominant classical temple architecture tradition of southern India.
hint: Its temples commonly feature large gopurams.
summary: Dravida architecture is the major classical temple architecture style of southern India.

title: What is the characteristic tower over the sanctum in Nagara temples called?
description: Identify the distinctive superstructure over the sanctum in northern Indian temples.
hint: It has a curvilinear form.
summary: The curvilinear tower over the sanctum in Nagara temples is called a shikhara.

title: What is the main tower over the sanctum in Dravida temples called?
description: Identify the pyramidal superstructure found above the sanctum in Dravidian temples.
hint: It is generally pyramidal in form.
summary: The main tower over the sanctum in Dravida temples is called a vimana.

title: Which feature is especially prominent in many South Indian temple complexes?
description: Identify the monumental entrance gateway commonly associated with Dravida temples.
hint: These gateways can be taller than the central shrine.
summary: Large gopurams are a prominent feature of many South Indian temple complexes.

title: Which architectural style is associated with temples such as Kandariya Mahadeva at Khajuraho?
description: Identify the temple architecture tradition represented by the Khajuraho temples.
hint: Khajuraho is in Madhya Pradesh.
summary: The Kandariya Mahadeva Temple represents the Nagara style of temple architecture.

title: The Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur is a major example of which style?
description: Identify the architectural tradition represented by the Brihadisvara Temple.
hint: It was built under the Cholas.
summary: The Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur is a major example of Dravida architecture.

title: The Sun Temple at Konark is primarily associated with which architectural tradition?
description: Identify the broad architectural style of the Konark Sun Temple.
hint: Konark is in Odisha.
summary: The Konark Sun Temple is an important example of the Nagara tradition in Odisha.

title: The temples of Khajuraho were primarily built under which dynasty?
description: Identify the dynasty responsible for the major temple-building activity at Khajuraho.
hint: They ruled parts of central India.
summary: The Chandela dynasty built the famous temples of Khajuraho.

title: The Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram was built during the rule of which dynasty?
description: Identify the dynasty associated with the Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram.
hint: The dynasty was prominent in Tamil Nadu before the imperial Cholas.
summary: The Shore Temple at Mahabalipuram was built during the Pallava period.

title: Which temple at Mahabalipuram is a monolithic rock-cut monument shaped like a chariot?
description: Identify the group of monolithic monuments commonly called Rathas.
hint: They are known by names such as Dharmaraja and Bhima Ratha.
summary: The Pancha Rathas at Mahabalipuram are monolithic rock-cut temples.

title: Which temple is a famous example of Hoysala architecture?
description: Identify a temple associated with the Hoysala architectural tradition.
hint: It is located at Belur.
summary: The Chennakesava Temple at Belur is a famous example of Hoysala architecture.

title: Which temple is located at Halebidu and is associated with Hoysala architecture?
description: Identify the famous Hoysala temple at Halebidu.
hint: It is dedicated to Shiva.
summary: The Hoysaleswara Temple at Halebidu is a major example of Hoysala architecture.

title: Which feature is particularly characteristic of Hoysala temples?
description: Identify an important architectural feature of Hoysala temples.
hint: Look at the ground plan and exterior walls.
summary: Hoysala temples are noted for star-shaped or stellate plans and highly ornate sculptural decoration.

title: Which temple is an important example of Kalinga architecture?
description: Identify the famous temple belonging to the Kalinga tradition of Odisha.
hint: It is located in Bhubaneswar.
summary: The Lingaraja Temple at Bhubaneswar is a major example of Kalinga architecture.

title: In Kalinga temple architecture, what is the term for the sanctum tower?
description: Identify the Odisha architectural term for the tower over the sanctum.
hint: It is the main vertical element over the garbhagriha.
summary: The sanctum tower in Kalinga architecture is known as the deul.

title: What is the sanctum of a Hindu temple commonly called?
description: Identify the Sanskrit-derived term for the innermost shrine of a Hindu temple.
hint: It literally relates to the womb or inner chamber.
summary: The sanctum of a Hindu temple is commonly called the garbhagriha.

title: What is a mandapa in Indian temple architecture?
description: Identify the function of the mandapa in a Hindu temple.
hint: It is a pillared hall.
summary: A mandapa is a pillared hall used for worship, gatherings, rituals, or other temple activities.

title: What is a gopuram?
description: Identify the architectural element known as a gopuram.
hint: It is usually associated with the entrance of South Indian temple complexes.
summary: A gopuram is a monumental gateway tower, especially prominent in South Indian temples.

title: Which temple is famous for its large gopurams and Dravidian architecture?
description: Identify the major temple complex in Madurai known for its monumental gateways.
hint: It is dedicated primarily to Meenakshi and Sundareswarar.
summary: The Meenakshi Amman Temple at Madurai is famous for its large gopurams and Dravidian architecture.

title: Which temple is associated with the Nagara style at Modhera?
description: Identify the famous Sun Temple at Modhera in Gujarat.
hint: It is dedicated to the Sun God.
summary: The Sun Temple at Modhera is an important example of the Nagara tradition.

title: Which temple is a major example of the Chalukyan architectural tradition at Pattadakal?
description: Identify a famous temple at Pattadakal associated with the Chalukyas.
hint: It is dedicated to Shiva.
summary: The Virupaksha Temple at Pattadakal is a major Chalukyan monument.

title: Which site is famous for a mixture of Nagara and Dravida architectural features?
description: Identify the site traditionally associated with experimentation between northern and southern temple forms.
hint: It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Karnataka.
summary: Pattadakal is noted for temples showing both Nagara and Dravida architectural influences.

title: The term 'Vesara' is commonly used to describe what?
description: Identify the architectural classification associated with a blend of northern and southern temple features.
hint: It combines elements of Nagara and Dravida traditions.
summary: Vesara is commonly used to describe temple forms combining Nagara and Dravida features, particularly in the Deccan.

title: Which temple is located at Aihole and is known for its experimental architectural plan?
description: Identify the famous early temple at Aihole often discussed in relation to Indian temple architecture.
hint: It has a distinctive apsidal plan.
summary: The Durga Temple at Aihole is noted for its apsidal plan and architectural experimentation.

title: The Kailasa Temple at Ellora was commissioned by which Rashtrakuta ruler?
description: Identify the ruler traditionally credited with commissioning the Kailasa Temple at Ellora.
hint: He was a prominent Rashtrakuta king.
summary: Rashtrakuta ruler Krishna I is traditionally credited with commissioning the Kailasa Temple at Ellora.

title: The Kailasa Temple at Ellora is primarily what type of monument?
description: Identify the construction technique used for the famous Kailasa Temple.
hint: The monument was carved from existing rock rather than assembled from blocks.
summary: The Kailasa Temple is a monolithic rock-cut temple carved from a single rock mass.

title: Which temple is located at Srirangam and is dedicated to Vishnu?
description: Identify the major Vaishnava temple complex on an island in the Kaveri River.
hint: It is dedicated to Ranganatha.
summary: The Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple at Srirangam is dedicated to Vishnu as Ranganatha.

title: Which architectural feature refers to an enclosure wall around a South Indian temple complex?
description: Identify the term for the enclosure surrounding many Dravidian temple complexes.
hint: It is often associated with temple precincts.
summary: A prakara is an enclosure wall or surrounding precinct of a temple complex.

title: What is the amalaka in Nagara temple architecture?
description: Identify the architectural element usually found near the top of a Nagara shikhara.
hint: It is generally ribbed and circular.
summary: The amalaka is a ribbed, disk-like stone element placed near the top of many Nagara temple towers.

title: Which temple is famous for its association with the Chola ruler Rajaraja I?
description: Identify the monumental temple commissioned during the reign of Rajaraja I.
hint: It is located in Thanjavur.
summary: Rajaraja I commissioned the Brihadisvara Temple at Thanjavur.

title: The Gangaikonda Cholapuram temple was built by which Chola ruler?
description: Identify the ruler who established Gangaikonda Cholapuram and built its famous temple.
hint: He succeeded Rajaraja I.
summary: Rajendra I built the Brihadisvara Temple at Gangaikonda Cholapuram.

title: Which temple is associated with the Nagara style and located in Bhubaneswar?
description: Identify the famous temple known for its Kalinga architectural features.
hint: It is dedicated to Shiva.
summary: The Mukteshwar Temple at Bhubaneswar is an important example of Kalinga architecture.

title: Which temple is famous for its elaborate stone carvings at Ranakpur?
description: Identify the religious tradition associated with the famous marble temple complex at Ranakpur.
hint: The temple is dedicated to the first Tirthankara.
summary: The Chaumukha Temple at Ranakpur is a famous Jain temple dedicated to Adinatha.

title: Which temple complex is located at Dilwara near Mount Abu?
description: Identify the famous group of Jain temples known for intricate marble work.
hint: They are in Rajasthan.
summary: The Dilwara Temples near Mount Abu are a famous group of Jain temples.

title: Which temple architecture tradition is particularly associated with Odisha?
description: Identify the regional temple architecture tradition of Odisha.
hint: It is a regional form of Nagara architecture.
summary: Kalinga architecture is the distinctive regional temple architecture tradition of Odisha.

title: What is the common architectural term for a temple entrance gateway?
description: Identify the Sanskrit-derived architectural term commonly used for a gateway.
hint: It can be elaborately decorated.
summary: A torana is a gateway or ornamental arch-like entrance structure.

title: Which temple complex is associated with the Vijayanagara Empire at Hampi?
description: Identify the famous temple dedicated to Virupaksha at Hampi.
hint: It remains an active temple.
summary: The Virupaksha Temple at Hampi is an important monument associated with the Vijayanagara period.

title: Which feature is strongly associated with Vijayanagara temple architecture?
description: Identify a characteristic feature of Vijayanagara temple complexes.
hint: Look at the monumental entrance structures.
summary: Large gopurams and extensive temple complexes are characteristic of Vijayanagara architecture.

title: Which temple at Hampi is famous for its stone chariot?
description: Identify the temple complex containing the iconic stone chariot.
hint: It is dedicated to Vittala.
summary: The Vittala Temple at Hampi is famous for its iconic stone chariot.

title: Which temple is an important example of Nagara architecture in Rajasthan?
description: Identify the famous temple at Osian associated with early medieval Rajasthan.
hint: It is dedicated to the Sun God.
summary: The Surya Temple at Osian is an important example of early medieval temple architecture in Rajasthan.

title: Which architectural element is generally located above the garbhagriha?
description: Identify the principal vertical superstructure associated with the temple sanctum.
hint: Its name differs between Nagara and Dravida traditions.
summary: A shikhara in Nagara temples and a vimana in Dravida temples rise above the sanctum.

title: Which temple is known for its distinctive erotic sculptures along with other themes?
description: Identify the famous temple group known for diverse sculptural themes.
hint: The site is in Madhya Pradesh.
summary: The Khajuraho temples are known for diverse sculptures, including erotic imagery.

title: Which temple architecture is characterized by a curvilinear shikhara?
description: Identify the major temple tradition associated with curving towers.
hint: It is dominant in northern India.
summary: Nagara architecture is characterized by curvilinear shikharas over the sanctum.

title: Which temple architecture style commonly has a pyramidal vimana?
description: Identify the temple tradition in which the superstructure over the sanctum is generally pyramidal.
hint: It is associated with southern India.
summary: Dravida temple architecture commonly features a pyramidal vimana.

title: Which temple at Pattadakal was built by Queen Lokamahadevi?
description: Identify the temple commissioned by Queen Lokamahadevi to commemorate a military victory.
hint: It is named after a major deity.
summary: Queen Lokamahadevi commissioned the Virupaksha Temple at Pattadakal.

title: Which temple is associated with the Hoysalas and located at Somanathapura?
description: Identify the famous Hoysala temple at Somanathapura.
hint: It is dedicated to Keshava.
summary: The Chennakeshava Temple at Somanathapura is a major Hoysala monument.

title: Which dynasty is especially associated with the development of monumental temples at Mahabalipuram?
description: Identify the dynasty responsible for major structural and rock-cut monuments at Mahabalipuram.
hint: Their capital was Kanchipuram.
summary: The Pallavas were especially associated with the development of monumental temples at Mahabalipuram.

title: Which temple is famous for its 1,000-pillared hall at Madurai?
description: Identify the major temple complex associated with the famous thousand-pillared hall.
hint: It is dedicated to Meenakshi and Sundareswarar.
summary: The Meenakshi Amman Temple complex at Madurai contains the famous Thousand Pillar Hall.

title: Which temple is a major example of the Nagara tradition in Madhya Pradesh?
description: Identify the famous temple at Khajuraho dedicated to Shiva.
hint: It is one of the largest and most elaborate temples at Khajuraho.
summary: The Kandariya Mahadeva Temple is a major example of Nagara architecture in Madhya Pradesh.
